tools.name: get_liquidation_map
tools.description: Where leveraged Bitcoin or Ethereum futures positions would be liquidated right now: CryptoKeyhole's live liquidation map, estimated by 0.5% price band from 15% below to 15% above the price, with the largest long and short clusters, the totals within 5% and the map's measured accuracy. tools.name: get_derivatives_snapshot
tools.description: The derivatives picture for Bitcoin or Ethereum now: futures liquidations in the last 24 hours (longs and shorts, hour by hour, and the total for every coin covered), the funding rate averaged across venues by open interest, total open interest with its 24-hour change, and the next options expiry's

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: A coin's daily closing price on a UTC day, or its change between two days with the highest and lowest daily close in between, from CryptoKeyhole's price history (Bitcoin from July 2010, Ethereum from August 2015, and the other coins covered). Leave end_date out for the change from start_date to toda

tools.name: get_eth_btc_ratio
tools.description: Ether priced in bitcoin: the ETH/BTC ratio now with its 30-day change, 200-day average and all-time high close, and its change between two UTC days when dates are given, from CryptoKeyhole's own hourly price indexes (daily closes since August 2015).

tools.name: get_support_levels
tools.description: Where Bitcoin's price stands against the levels traders watch: the 200-day, 200-week and 1-year averages, the bull market support band, the Pi Cycle Bottom line, the realized price and the power-law lines, each with its distance from the price.

tools.name: get_exchange_reserves
tools.description: Coins CryptoKeyhole can see on chain at each exchange that publishes its addresses (proof of reserves): bitcoin, ether and stablecoins in US dollars, net flows over 24 hours and 7 days, and open flags such as unusual outflows or paused withdrawals. Leave exchange out for every covered exchange.

tools.name: get_etf_flows
tools.description: Daily net flows of the US spot ETFs of one coin (or of every coin together with ALL), from the issuers' own daily files: the latest day, the largest fund that day, the last 5 and 30 trading days and total holdings.

tools.name: get_assets_list
tools.description: List the coins CryptoKeyhole covers, each with its code and name. Use a code as the asset argument of the other tools.

tools.name: get_metrics_list
tools.description: Search or list the metrics (charts) of one asset, BTC by default, by words in query or by category. The same rows as get_asset_metrics: each has the exact metric id, name, unit, intervals, history and the plan its data needs; fetch_metric reads rows whose plan is free.

tools.name: get_asset_metrics
tools.description: Search or list the metrics (charts) of one asset by words in query (for example "puell" or "exchange balance") or by category. Use it to find the exact metric id before get_metric_metadata or fetch_metric; ids are looked up here, never guessed. Each row has the plan its data needs; fetch_metric read

tools.name: get_metric_metadata
tools.description: Read one metric's definition by its exact id from get_asset_metrics: what it measures, method, unit, intervals, coverage, source and limitations.

tools.name: fetch_metric
tools.description: Read one metric's observations by its exact id from get_asset_metrics: exact decimal strings with original source clocks, revision, finality and gaps. End is exclusive. No new observation is acquired. Without an API key it serves metrics whose plan is free at 24h, 1w, 1M or 1Y; a chart above the fre

tools.name: fetch_bulk_metrics
tools.description: Read several metric selections in one call, each by its exact id. Each item keeps its own provenance and revision; this is not one atomic snapshot. Unsupported selections are explicit per-item errors. The combined result is bounded at 200000 observations and the response-byte limit.

tools.name: find_extremes
tools.description: Which charts of a coin, or of every coin, stand furthest from normal right now: each chart's latest reading against its own last four years (z-score and percentile), high or low, with the days since it was last this far out. The quickest way to see what is unusual on chain, in derivatives or in flow

tools.name: get_screener_fields
tools.description: List the fields screen_assets can test, with how many coins have each: ids such as market.Mvrv, market.PriceUsdClose or derivatives.FuturesFundingRatePerpetual. Search them by words.

tools.name: screen_assets
tools.description: Screen every coin CryptoKeyhole covers by the latest readings of its charts, for example coins with MVRV below 1, funding below zero or price 60% under its high. tools.name: correlate_metrics
tools.description: How closely two metrics move together over a window: the Pearson correlation of their period-over-period changes (log changes when both stay above zero) and of their levels, and the rolling correlation of changes, from the two exact series.
